android_apis.finding: COLOR_FormatYUVP010 is 10-bit 4:2:0 semiplanar, little-endian 16-bit words with 10 MSB data, intended for Image input.
Returns writable raw input Image. Calling getInputImage invalidates previously returned ByteBuffer/Image views for that index. Adapter records capacity before acquiring Image.
P010 format is 54; low six bits of each 16-bit little-endian word are zero.
Hardware acceleration is a manufacturer-supplied attribute, not a tested correctness or fidelity guarantee.
Encoder config explicitly sets BT2020, HLG, full/limited range, HEVC profile and P010 color format.
